fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance strategic plan 2025/26-2029/30 budgets UGX 0.10 billion a year, UGX 0.50 billion in all, to finalize the review of the National ICT Policy, and lists the National ICT Policy 2014 among the policies guiding the Ministry.
title: ICT Strategic Plan FY 2025/2026 - 2029/2030
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communications Technology and National Guidance
